question: Related Questions Q. I would be grateful if you could answer a couple of quick questions for me. I am a chartered accountant from Lahore, Pakistan. Also is it against Islam to visit people 1) who proclaim to cure people by reading verses from the Quran or 2) who proclaim that they are blessed with healing powers. If this is ok in Islam, then would you know of any one? I understand that you are very busy, but would be extremely grateful for an early reply. 3439 views Q. Assalamualaikum mufti sahab , Khairiat ? Assalaamu alaikum wa rahmatullah, Dear Sheikh, I pray to Allah SWT that you are enjoying a good health & high Islamic spirit. (1) It has come to my knowledge that some people observe certain nawwafil salaah by reciting any specific surah a certain number of times( that is more than once) in each raka'ah after reading surah faati'ha. Sometimes they would make an extra sajdah after reading the tashahhud & darood and there, they would ask for any specific doah they are in need for. They would even call this salah as haajaat. However I have not cross of any of this kind of salaah in the ahadeeth. Could you please enlighten me on this. (2) My second question is about those 'aamil who after asking someone's name & mother's name, claim that they make istikhaarah salah in order to find out if that person is under the influence of jiin or evil eyes etc. As far as i understand, Istikhaarah salaah is accomplished when someone is unsure of whether doing something is good for him/her or not. But what I don't understand is how Istikhaarah salaah can help someone to find out the malady of someone else. Would that not be more appropriate to offer haajah salaah in this context? I look forward to your valuable views and comments on the above two issues Incha Allah. I thank you in anticipation for your cooperation. Wassalaam. 2469 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 39439 Country: Pakistan Title: Nullifying the effects of a taweez from Amal-e-Qurani Question: My problem is extremely serious, please help me. I was in serious love with a girl and truly want to marry her but we broke up 3 years ago. The cause of break up was a tawiz from Amaal-e-Qurani of Maulana Ashraf Ali Thanvi. I had this book and we had a minor fight and I got angry and did this tawiz to separate us. The tawiz had an ayah ``wa alqaina bayna humul......ila yawm il qayamata ``. After six months of the break up I tore the tawiz and threw its pieces in a lawn, but the effect did not go away. She is also depressed and misses me. But we do not want to talk to each other. We are 27 each and we both want to marry but we are out of touch for last three years. Kindly tell a remedy where the effect of that tawiz is completely finished and we get back along as before. The tawiz is from Amal-e-Qurani of Maulana Ashraf Ali Thanvi and nobody has given me a remedy so far, although I have been to various scholars. Please help me we want to get married as soon as possible. Answer ID: 39439 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 921/916/N=1433) It was good that both of you were separated due to tawiz or by any other thing. According to Shariah it is not right to develop friendship or relationship with any strange girl. If you want to marry her then talk to your parents about it and seek their consent and then marry her. It is not good to marry a girl without the permission and consent of one’s parents. But if you feel any hatred in your heart towards the girl and it seems the effect of the tawiz then consult any good and pious amil. I am unaware of amaliyat. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
